name: 01-security-layers
prompt: Create an original polished technical editorial infographic for a Chinese engineering article, wide landscape about 1600x1000. White background, ink-navy typography, purple/cobalt technical line art, restrained mint and coral accents. Crisp line-art icons, clean connector routing, ample whitespace, readable simplified Chinese labels. Professional developer-documentation diagrams inspired by the clarity of Cloudflare engineering illustrations and pgroll timelines, but original composition, no copied logos, no watermark. NOT a grid of pastel rounded cards, not a text slide, no tiny paragraphs. Use the exact labels supplied; no invented measurements. Strong diagram hierarchy and clear causal arrows. No decoration without explanatory purpose. Title "Web 应用的八层防线". Central horizontal request journey: browser icon "浏览器" → gateway/shield icon "网络入口" → identity key icon "认证与授权" → service gears icon "业务规则" → row-lock/transaction icon "并发控制" → database cylinder "数据存储". Show numbered small circles 1 through 6 above each respective stage. Their short labels under icons respectively "安全渲染", "TLS · 限流", "租户 · 对象权限", "资格 · 幂等", "事务 · 唯一约束", "参数化 · 最小权限". A dashed trust boundary between browser and gateway labeled "客户端输入不可信". A second lower broad infrastructure rail spanning all six with server/cloud line-art label "7  基础设施与密钥". Third lower observability rail spanning all six using small pulse/eye icon "8  监控、审计与恢复". Three small coral arrows representing attacks stopped at gateway, authorization and database respectively, not all blocked by WAF. Bottom insight "每一层验证不同事实". Keep main journey clear left to right, not zigzag.

name: 05-ddl-locks
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished original Chinese technical editorial infographic for a serious engineering article. Asset: wide 16:10 high-resolution diagram. Pure warm white background; ink navy outlines, deep purple and cobalt plus restrained orange and mint accents. Reference design principles: crisp Cloudflare technical line-art symbols, pgroll's precisely aligned horizontal timing bars, polished developer documentation. Not a screenshot, no branding, no watermark. Strong editorial typography, generous deliberate whitespace, sophisticated hierarchy. Do not create a generic grid of rounded cards or tiny dense text. All labels must be perfectly spelled simplified Chinese and the exact English identifiers below. Use large readable text.
Subject: PostgreSQL online DDL compares long exclusive lock vs short exclusive lock followed by longer weaker validation. One clear explanatory chart, not a poster.
Title exactly "在线 DDL：缩短强锁占用".
Two horizontal timelines sharing time direction right. Top label "直接加 CHECK"; a long coral-red segment labeled "强锁 + 全表校验", with several small application request arrows visibly waiting below it labeled "业务读写等待". Bottom label "拆成两步"; very short coral segment labeled "NOT VALID" followed, after a visible commit gap, by a long teal segment labeled "VALIDATE", with blue request arrows running in parallel below labeled "普通读写可继续". Clear dashed commit milestone between bottom segments labeled "提交并释放强锁". Short side legend coral "强锁" teal "较弱锁". Minimal footer sentence exactly "验证仍有锁和资源开销，不等于完全无影响".
Essential accuracy: NOT VALID and VALIDATE are in different committed transactions, not drawn inside one transaction; chart is conceptual duration not measured data, no numbers. Do not add SQL or additional paragraphs. Beautiful balanced wide composition.
edit_prompt: Edit this technical infographic preserving its title, all Chinese and English text, palette, lock-duration bars, timeline positions and overall composition. Make exactly one technical correction: in the bottom 拆成两步 timeline, remove ALL blue normal-read-write arrows and the blue bracket that currently extend under the red NOT VALID stage. Red NOT VALID holds a strong lock, so ordinary reads/writes must NOT be illustrated continuing through it. The blue arrows and bracket labelled 普通读写可继续 must begin ONLY below the GREEN VALIDATE segment, after the dashed 提交并释放强锁 milestone, and continue to the end of the green bar. Keep the red NOT VALID stage with NO normal-read-write arrows underneath. Preserve all other elements unchanged and readable. Do not use a code tool; edit the image itself.
